title: Run the react harness family through CLI tool_loop init
narrative: Fangore switches the host to the classic ReAct family so models without reliable native tool calls still loop Thought/Action/Observation. He starts from the same CLI tool-loop verb, with family=react bound at harness initialization, and expects a final answer after one scripted tool round.
implementation: `CliScenario.host.family` / `tool_loop.family=react` select `ReactHarness` via `_CliToolLoopConfig.get_harness_class` (Config DI). Story harness scripts Action/Final Answer turns on `ScriptedInference`. Emits the same EventLog inference/tool stream as other families.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `react_tool_round.yaml`: host family react, tool_loop family=react, hard expects on status/text, core:inference in event_types, cost_units and total_tokens ceilings.
